messages: #p320# asked me for help one last time. This time, he wants me to get #b30 #t4000034#s#k, #b10 #t4000050#s#k, and #b1 #t4020107##k by taking down #r#o37#s#k and #r#o45#s#k. I guess I can do it, but hunting down in the deep parts of the Ant Tunnel... This is way too hard!!

I got all the materials #p320# needed for the last time. Is this it? For the reward, he gave me a scroll for shoes he got as a gift from the fairies, who found it somewhere around the forest. He couldn't figure out how to use the scroll, so I'm getting it... hopefully it works... haha...
